title: fix(cli): os dev's in-place organization-ownership upgrade names what stopped it, and the command that carries on
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XQ5pdkuCpFo7HHTQm6TUo9U)_

Fixes #26615

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`os dev` 遇到旧开发库被启动保护拒绝、就地升级又没跑完时，不再只说「The upgrade did not run to a report」。它会打印仪式自己的拒绝原文（终端强制彩色时也读得到），或者仪式是怎么结束的（退出码、信号）加日志末尾；最后给出一条能直接接着跑的完整命令（带数据库和它写好的计划文件）。
- **为什么改**：卡片里开发者拉了一周 main 后启动失败，只拿到一句没有原因的话。这里在五种旧库形态上都复现不出那次具体的停止（包括 10 月 16 日的 HotCRM 真实旧库 + 已发布的 18.2.0，都升级成功），但找到了三处会把原因吞掉的代码路径，现在都会说出原因。
- **风险与回滚**：只动 `os dev` 的就地升级读结果和打印的那一层；生产 `os migrate … --apply` 仪式本身一行没改，升级前的备份照旧保留。回滚即还原 `packages/cli/src/utils/dev-organization-ownership-upgrade.ts`。
- **先看**：`packages/cli/src/utils/dev-organization-ownership-upgrade.ts`（`stopCause` 与 `readApplyOutcome`）、`packages/cli/test/dev-organization-ownership-stale-column.integration.test.ts`、`scripts/check-cli-test-child-env.mjs`（名单加一行）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run src/utils/dev-organization-ownership-upgrade.test.ts`，应见 13 条全绿，其中「a refusal printed in colour is read in the ceremony's own words」。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`os dev`'s in-place upgrade of a development database the organization-ownership boot guard refused (`upgradeDevelopmentDatabase`, ADR-0131 D10 development exception) now never ends without its cause:

- **The ceremony's refusal, in its own words, also in colour.** The refusal lines are read from the ceremony log with colour stripped (`stripVTControlCharacters`). Before, a terminal that forces colour (`FORCE_COLOR`) made chalk write `ESC[31m  ✗ Refused: …` into the log, the reader's `startsWith('✗')` matched nothing, and the stop printed no cause. Measured: `FORCE_COLOR=1 os migrate organization-ownership --dev --apply …` writes exactly that byte shape to a file. The `✗` glyph is now the printer's alone, no longer doubled (`✗ ✗ Refused`).
- **A stop with no refusal of its own names how it ended.** The apply's exit used to be ignored. An uncaught error (printed by oclif as `Error: …`), a crash or a signal printed no `✗` line, so nothing was shown. Now the upgrade prints `` `os migrate organization-ownership --dev --apply` exited with code N `` (or `was ended by SIGNAL`, or `could not be started`), then the end of that run's own part of the log, without the kernel's timestamped INFO/DEBUG narration and without the plan run's output.
- **A report file that is not a report is read as none.** The apply reserves its `--out` file before it boots, holding a reservation text. A run that stopped between the reservation and the report left that text, which the upgrade parsed as a report with no verdict and printed 「The upgrade stopped at a blocker (above)」 with nothing above. A file that did not parse threw out of `os dev`. Both are now "no report", with the cause. A blocked report that names no blocker prints the log's cause too.
- **No silent drop (seat ruling C, 6446501014).** A stale `organization_id` the plan gives the column-drop fate is a column the plan accounts for, so the upgrade proceeds, but before the apply runs `os dev` prints one line per column-drop table whose retired column held non-null stamps: the table, how many stamped values the drop discards (the plan's `fateCounts.rowsLosingTheirStamp`), and that the copy keeps them. A table with no stamps is not named. A column the plan gives no fate still refuses the plan.
- **The exact command that carries on.** Every failed upgrade ends on `os migrate organization-ownership --dev --database-url URL --apply --plan-file PLAN --backup-taken`, with the database the boot opened and the plan the upgrade wrote. The apply resumes from its checkpoint and prints the stop on the developer's terminal.

The copy taken before the upgrade is kept exactly as before. The production ceremony (`os migrate organization-ownership --apply` without `--dev`) is unchanged: no file under `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/` or `packages/runtime` is touched.

## Tests

- `packages/cli/src/utils/dev-organization-ownership-upgrade.test.ts`: six new cases (a coloured refusal, an uncaught error with kernel narration around it, a signal, the reservation text left behind, an unparseable report file, a blocked report with no blocker), and the existing cases read the un-doubled refusal and the exact command; a seventh (ruling C) pins that a `sys_secret` column drop discarding 3 stamps is announced exactly once before the apply, a drop with 0 stamps is not, and the upgrade completes. 13/13 (ablating the `rows > 0` filter turns the C pin red: 1 failed | 12 passed).
- `packages/cli/test/dev-organization-ownership-stale-column.integration.test.ts` (new, integration tier, the card's third target): a fresh `os dev` creates the database, the staging step gives `sys_flow_credential` and `sys_secret` the injected `organization_id` column and its `idx_TABLE_organization_id` index with unstamped rows, and deletes the marker (the 18.0 pre-release shape). A plain `os dev` on it is refused, upgraded in place and starts (「server started on the upgraded database」). Both columns are gone, the marker is verified, the rows are kept, and the copy still has both columns. The `sys_secret` row is stamped with a real `sys_organization` id, and `os dev` prints its stamped-count line before "Upgraded the development database" and does not name the unstamped `sys_flow_credential`. 5/5. It joins the built-entrypoint census of `scripts/check-cli-test-child-env.mjs` (seventeen → eighteen, with its reason).

<details><summary>Red first: the new cases against the base source</summary>

The base `dev-organization-ownership-upgrade.ts` (`5cc31c7885`), restored from `HEAD` afterwards (`git diff HEAD` empty), driven by a copy of the test whose fake answers the base seam's `number`:

```
× a refused plan changes nothing and boots nothing: its refusal is printed, with the copy's location
× a blocked step boots nothing: each blocker is printed, and how to resume
× ⭐ a refusal printed in colour is read in the ceremony's own words
× an apply that stopped with no refusal of its own (an uncaught error) names how it ended and the end of its log
× an apply ended by a signal says so
× a report file still holding the apply's reservation text is no report: the cause is printed, not "a blocker (above)"
× a report file that does not parse is named, never thrown
× a blocked report that names no blocker prints the log's cause instead of an empty "above"
Tests  8 failed | 4 passed (12)
```

The first two are the un-doubled glyph and the exact command; the other six are the swallowed causes.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The reported stop did not reproduce in this container.** The reporter's database (`.objectstack/data/backups/organization-ownership-2026-10-27T10-08-08-349Z`) is on the reporter's machine. Five shapes were measured, and each completed the upgrade and started: (1) a one-object fixture on `main`, both columns added, no marker; (2) the same with a shape-generation-0 birth marker; (3) HotCRM `afdf9a0` on `main` with the columns, the indexes, and stamped rows in both tables; (4) the same on the **published 18.2.0** install; (5) an **authentic** HotCRM database written by HotCRM `4f82b81` (2026-10-16, platform `18.0.0-next.2`), then started by HotCRM on the published 18.2.0. Its plan carried exactly `sys_flow_credential` and `sys_secret` as column-drop tables with the column, `column-drops done {"dropped":2}`. The test fixture stands in for the reporter's backup. With this change, running `os dev` on that backup prints the cause the ceremony hit. The `ceremony.log` beside the backup already holds it.
- **Target 2 measured: already handled.** `sys_flow_credential` and `sys_secret` carry inventory fate `column-drop` (`organization-ownership-inventory.ts`), and the dev-mode ceremony drops both columns through the drift door, index included. The new test pins it. No ceremony change was needed.
- **The ruling's data line** was decided by the seat (ruling C, 6446501014): proceed, and print what each column drop discards. A blanket refusal would refuse every 17.x dev database, because `sys_audit_log` and the `sys_metadata` family are column-drop tables and always stamped.
- Open PRs on the file surface, read at start and before this PR: only #26337 touches `organization-ownership-inventory.ts` (not touched here). Card #26687 has no PR yet.
